name: high-end-fullbody-fashion
image_vibe: High-end cinematic studio, confident elegant realism, minimalist luxury
image_purpose: Create a vertical lookbook/editorial fashion portrait with exact approved-adult face continuity.

prompt.project_info: A 4:5 ultra-realistic cinematic fashion editorial portrait in a minimalist studio.
prompt.main_subject: The approved adult woman from the required face reference sits on a modern beige armchair with wooden legs, leaning slightly forward with hands gently together and a confident gaze directed at the camera. Preserve her exact approved facial structure, hairstyle, natural skin tone, and overall identity without beautification.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical framing, beige armchair centered against a light-gray smooth gradient background, relaxed confident seated posture, and clear visibility of the navy top, beige pants, and black loafers with tan soles.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural studio lighting with even exposure and subtle shadows for depth, refined cinematic atmosphere, and realistic furniture/fabric rendering.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 vertical frame, 50mm lens, f/2.8, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, ultra-realistic skin and fabric texture, no CGI, cartoon, or stylized effect.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 ultra-realistic cinematic fashion editorial portrait of the approved adult woman from the required face reference. Preserve her exact real face, facial structure, hairstyle, natural skin tone, body proportions, and overall identity without alterations or beautification. Seat her on a modern beige armchair with wooden legs, leaning slightly forward with hands gently together and an intense confident gaze at camera. Dress her in a dark navy blue fitted blouse or dress shirt with top buttons slightly open, light beige slim-fit pants, and black loafers with tan soles. Use a light-gray minimalist smooth-gradient background, soft natural studio lighting, subtle shadows, 50mm lens at f/2.8, vertical full-body composition, realistic skin, fabric, and furniture detail, and high-end cinematic fashion aesthetics. No text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, transparent clothing, altered face, changed hairstyle, artificial beauty filter, CGI, cartoon, illustration, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: approved adult face and identity reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult woman's face, facial structure, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, and identity exactly; do not substitute a celebrity or public-figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The face reference must be attached and kept consistent. Preserve the navy top, beige pants, black loafers, armchair, light-gray gradient, full-body 4:5 framing, and studio lighting; only non-essential background details may vary.
